@vdeherde82 @pcmasuzzo The #metoo movement is about women’s accusations of sexual abuse being taken seriously by official channels and thus showing no one is above the law.

Fomenting mob justice and refusing to cooperate with legal processes endangers our fight, and this is something I cannot support.

@pcmasuzzo @open_con Claims of fear of retaliation are bogus given:

1. How freely and openly accusations were voiced on social media.

2. How massive the blind support from the community was expected to be given widespread support in academia for #Metoo.

Hence, why no formal accusations?
